newsitem.title: USA: Meditrust Q2 real estate investments $159 mln.
newsitem.headline: Meditrust Q2 real estate investments $159 mln.

text.p: Meditrust SBI said Thursday it completed $159 million in real estate investments in the quarter ended June 30.

In the first six months of 1997, it completed $274 million of real estate investments, it said. Meditrust had existing financing commitments of about $202 million for ongoing real estate projects as of June 30.

Sale/leaseback financing of $73 million was funded for 22 assisted living facilities in Florida, New York, Oregon, Texas, Washington, Wisconsin and Wyoming, and for one nursing home and one medical office building in Massachusetts.
Permanent mortgage financing of $4 million was provided for one nursing home in South Carolina, and $4 million was provided for additions to facilities already in the portfolio.
Meditrust also funded $23 million for development of six assisted living facilities in Florida, Indiana and Utah and for three medical office buildings in Florida.
The company also funded $55 million for ongoing construction of facilities already in the portfolio.
